configuration: The official 10-time-unit horizon is retained with four fixed observations.
observable: Star and tracer Cartesian states with and without test-particle back reaction.
default_vs_upstream: The official 10-time-unit horizon is retained with four fixed observations.
variant: input.json changes perturb_ulps from 0 to 2; produce.py moves the explicitly selected active mass, position, semi-major axis or oscillator displacement toward +infinity by two binary64 ULPs.
altbuild: GCC -O3 -mfma -ffp-contract=fast instead of baseline GCC -O3; source, nominal inputs and observation times are unchanged. The calibration host must support x86 FMA.

comparison.rule: pointwise: every named scalar of observables.json (star and tracer Cartesian states with and without test-particle back reaction) is compared by its physical key, body identity from the input deck and frame at a fixed physical time, |candidate - reference| <= atol + rtol x |reference| with atol=1e-10, rtol=1e-09, and the candidate must write exactly the reference key set; the star and tracer states are recorded with and without test-particle back reaction at four fixed times through t=10 under the compensated gravity routine; nothing is excluded.

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-16: run.sh altbuild (GCC -O3 -mfma -ffp-contract=fast instead of GCC -O3 on the same source and nominal inputs.) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: all physical scalars within bound

native_investigation.physical_fault: Stop at 99% of every required physical output time while retaining the required output keys.
native_investigation.scope: Native Linux x86_64 investigation; not the CLI Docker self-validation record and not evidence of GPU equivalence.

native_source_mutation.mutation: Replace r->testparticle_type by 0 in the four local _testparticle_type declarations in src/gravity.c.
native_source_mutation.scope: Native Linux x86_64 source mutation experiment, separate from formal Docker self-validation.

altbuild.what: GCC -O3 -mfma -ffp-contract=fast instead of GCC -O3 on the same source and nominal inputs.

warrant:
This check compares Star and tracer Cartesian states with and without test-particle back reaction. src/gravity.c evaluates gravitational interactions and the selected src/integrator_*.c advances the named bodies; compensated sums, splitting and adaptive error control change roundoff accumulation. The native two-ULP experiment measured maximum absolute spread 6.9944050551384862e-15, using 1.1098481390646642e-05 of the proposed bound at the worst scalar. The native alternative-build floor was 0; identical graded output does not establish portability across architectures. The deliberately wrong problem (Stop at 99% of every required physical output time while retaining the required output keys.) was rejected at 151443507.30619955 times the bound. The user accepted this bound after calibration. A separate native experiment replaced the four local test-particle-type reads in src/gravity.c by zero, suppressing gravitational back reaction in the actual compiled C implementation. This reaction-disabled control remained byte-identical to its unmodified reference, as required by its physical configuration.

See evidence.altbuild and evidence.self_validation_bound_fraction for the CLI-measured FMA and two-ULP calibration of this contract. The user accepted these numerical bounds after calibration. These fixed-deck measurements are not a GPU performance result or an absolute scientific error estimate.
